sources.name: State Customs Service of Ukraine: foreign-trade statistics and open data (exports of natural honey by destination)
sources.official_body: Derzhmytsluzhba (State Customs Service of Ukraine), under the Ministry of Finance; datasets published on the national open-data portal data.gov.ua (CKAN)
sources.access_method: Web statistics section on customs.gov.ua (XLSX/HTML) and data.gov.ua datasets (CSV/XLSX) through the CKAN API v3. NOT verified in this session: customs.gov.ua and data.gov.ua were blocked by the egress proxy (CONNECT 403), and the web-search budget ran out before any Ukrainian query returned results.
endpoints: https://customs.gov.ua/statistika-ta-reiestri   (customs statistics and registers landing page; path from memory)
https://data.gov.ua/organization/derzhavna-mitna-sluzhba-ukrayini   (publisher page on the open-data portal; slug from memory)
https://data.gov.ua/api/3/action/package_search?q=УКТЗЕД%20експорт&rows=50   (standard CKAN search; use it to find the monthly export/import-by-commodity datasets)
https://data.gov.ua/api/3/action/package_show?id={dataset_id}   (standard CKAN: resources[].url gives the CSV/XLSX download)
Honey line to filter: UKTZED 0409 00 00 00 ('Мед натуральний'), or 0409 at 4 digits
sources.auth: none (public open data); CKAN read API needs no key
sources.cost_licensing: Free. data.gov.ua datasets normally carry CC BY 4.0 (memory; check each dataset's license_id field).
sources.update_frequency: monthly (customs statistics); dataset refresh cadence on data.gov.ua varies
sources.publication_lag: Normally about 2-4 weeks after month end for customs aggregates (memory). Under martial law some detail has been delayed or withheld since 2022.
sources.data_available: Expected: exports and imports by UKTZED code and by partner country, with customs value (USD thousand, sometimes UAH) and net weight (t or kg). That gives an official export unit value in USD/kg by destination (EU members, US, others). Whether the open datasets go down to 10 digits × country, or only to 2/4-digit commodity groups, is UNVERIFIED. If only chapter 04 is published, honey is not separable (chapter 04 also covers dairy and eggs).
sources.value_for_parodi: Highest potential value in this region. Ukraine is the EU's first or second honey supplier, and its 35,000 t DCFTA TRQ has applied since 29 Oct 2025. Official Ukrainian export volumes and USD/kg by destination would arrive weeks before the Comext mirror (6-7 weeks). They also cover non-EU destinations (US, Middle East) that Eurostat cannot show, and they track quota pressure. Ukrainian agri media (Latifundist, UkrAgroConsult) quote monthly honey export volumes 'according to the State Customs Service', so the figures exist; the open question is the machine-readable route.
sources.rate_limits: No documented limit for CKAN reads; be polite (≤1 req/s).
sources.parsing_notes: 1) Verify first: open data.gov.ua and search for datasets from the customs publisher with 'УКТЗЕД' or 'експорт товарів'. Check granularity (digits × country × month) before building anything. 2) Values are usually in USD thousand, so convert to EUR with the ECB reference rate already integrated, using the monthly average. 3) Country names are in Ukrainian, so map them to ISO2 with a lookup table. 4) Fallback if granularity is too coarse: parse the monthly honey figures that Ukrainian agri media attribute to customs (already in the news research). Label them third-party. 5) Cross-check against Comext partner UA imports for EU27.
sources.sample_response: RECONSTRUCTED (not seen): CSV columns like 'Період;Код УКТЗЕД;Назва товару;Країна;Експорт, тис. дол. США;Експорт, кг;Імпорт, тис. дол. США;Імпорт, кг' → '2026-08;0409000000;Мед натуральний;Польща;…;…'

sources.name: ISTAT 'Statistiche del commercio estero' (new foreign-trade database that replaced Coeweb) on the IstatData/esploradati platform, plus the ISTAT SDMX web service
sources.access_method: Web databrowser on IstatData (a .Stat Suite / SDMX-RI platform) with CSV/XLSX export. The platform also exposes an SDMX 2.1 REST web service at esploradati.istat.it/SDMXWS. Whether the foreign-trade cubes are published as SDMX dataflows on that service is NOT verified. IMPORTANT: Coeweb (coeweb.istat.it) was shut down on 30 Sep 2025 (last update 11 Sep 2025), and the new database has 'the same information content'. Any code or plan that targets Coeweb must be redirected.
endpoints: https://esploradati.istat.it/coeweb/databrowser/#/it   (new foreign-trade databrowser address, as cited by a Regione FVG page; not opened in this session)
https://esploradati.istat.it/SDMXWS/rest/dataflow/IT1   (list all dataflows; look for foreign-trade/commercio estero flows)
https://esploradati.istat.it/SDMXWS/rest/datastructure/IT1/{DSD_ID}?references=children   (dimension order and codelists; check that the product codelist contains NC8 04090000)

https://esploradati.istat.it/SDMXWS/rest/data/{flowRef}/{key}?startPeriod=2024-01&endPeriod=2026-09   (SDMX REST data; key = dot-separated dimension codes in DSD order; Accept: application/vnd.sdmx.data+csv;version=1.0.0 for SDMX-CSV)
sources.auth: None for browsing and SDMX reads (memory). The old Coeweb needed a free registration for full data access according to a university note; unverified for the new database.
sources.cost_licensing: Free. ISTAT content is released under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, cited as 'Fonte: Istat' (memory; check the site's Note legali).
sources.publication_lag: Extra-EU provisional aggregates about 25 days after month end. Full EU and extra-EU product × country detail about 40-50 days after month end, which is similar to Comext. (memory)
sources.data_available: Italy imports and exports by Combined Nomenclature 8-digit code (NC8 04090000 natural honey; also SH2/SH4/SH6, ATECO/CPA and SITC views) × partner country × month. Value in EUR and quantity in kg net mass, from which EUR/kg is derived. Territorial view by Italian region/province × product × country (quarterly/annual). Extra-EU imports are attributed to country of origin, intra-EU to country of consignment (memory).
sources.value_for_parodi: This is the official national figure for Parodi's home market. The underlying Intrastat/Extrastat data is the same as Eurostat Comext DS-045409 (reporter IT), which is already integrated, so the trade series is mainly a cross-check. The unique addition is the provincial/regional breakdown: which Italian provinces import honey from Ukraine, China or Argentina, and at what unit value. That serves as a proxy for competing packers' sourcing. Also fixes any reliance on the dead Coeweb.
sources.rate_limits: The ISTAT SDMX service is reported (istatapi documentation) to allow about 5 requests per minute per IP and to block offending IPs for a day or more (memory). Space requests at least 15 s apart and cache structure calls.
sources.parsing_notes: 1) The trade dataflow ID and DSD were not retrievable: esploradati.istat.it and www.istat.it are outside this session's allowed network domains. ISTAT notes that after the SDMX-RI migration some dataflows changed dimension positions in REST keys, so always read the DSD first. 2) If trade is not exposed as SDMX, record the databrowser's export call (the .Stat Data Explorer calls the same NSI web service) to get the flow ID. 3) Store reference period and publication date; recent months are revised. 4) Partner codes are probably ISO2 (Serbia may be 'RS' here but 'XS' in Comext), so map carefully.

sources.name: AKI PÁIR (Agricultural Market Price Information System): honey purchase prices (acacia, rapeseed, sunflower, multifloral)
sources.official_body: Agrárközgazdasági Intézet (AKI, Institute of Agricultural Economics), the state agricultural-economics institute under the Hungarian Ministry of Agriculture, which runs the official market price information system PÁIR
sources.access_method: Web portal and periodic market reports (HTML/PDF/XLSX). No API known. NOT verified: aki.gov.hu was not reachable, and searches ran out before Hungary.
endpoints: https://aki.gov.hu   (publications: agricultural market reports / 'Agrárpiaci jelentések'; look for 'Méz')
sources.cost_licensing: Free public information; reuse with attribution (terms unverified)
sources.data_available: Expected: honey purchase prices (felvásárlási ár) paid to beekeepers by honey type (akácméz/acacia, repceméz/rapeseed, napraforgóméz/sunflower, vegyes virágméz/multifloral), in HUF/kg, possibly with export price indications. Whether this is a regular series or only appears in occasional reports is UNVERIFIED.
sources.value_for_parodi: If confirmed, this would be the only official EU bulk price series for acacia honey from Hungary, a core EU origin for Parodi (Hungary and Romania acacia). It would feed directly into supplier-quote benchmarking. Comext cannot provide it because it carries no variety detail. It would rank high once verified.
sources.parsing_notes: Verify that a honey series exists and how often it is published before coding. Convert HUF to EUR with the ECB rate. Keep the HUF original and note the price basis (purchase price from producers, VAT excluded or not).
sources.sample_response: RECONSTRUCTED: table 'Méz felvásárlási ára (Ft/kg)': Időszak | Akácméz | Repceméz | Napraforgóméz | Vegyes virágméz

sources.name: MAPA honey price reports ('Precios del sector miel' / 'Informe sectorial miel') and apiculture sector indicators (REGA hive census)
sources.official_body: Ministerio de Agricultura, Pesca y Alimentación (MAPA), Subdirección General de Análisis, Coordinación y Estadística
sources.access_method: PDF reports, one per campaign (verified PDF URLs below). The hive census and sector indicators come as PDF/XLSX on the MAPA apiculture sector page (memory). No API.
endpoints: Older campaigns use the same folder with names like precios_sector_miel_campana_2013-2014_tcm34-452127.pdf (the tcm IDs are not predictable, so discover them through the statistics index pages)

https://www.mapa.gob.es/es/ganaderia/temas/produccion-y-mercados-ganaderos/sectores-ganaderos/apicola/   (sector page with 'Indicadores económicos del sector apícola' and REGA hive census; path from memory)
sources.cost_licensing: Free. Spanish public-sector information reuse (Ley 37/2007) with attribution to MAPA (memory).
sources.update_frequency: annual (one report per campaign, with monthly price points inside)
sources.publication_lag: Several months after the campaign ends. The latest one found covers 2023/24; a 2024/25 edition probably exists but was not found.
sources.data_available: Producer prices (precios percibidos) in EUR/kg by month within each campaign for 'Miel Multifloral a Granel' (bulk multifloral), monofloral honeys (rosemary, orange blossom, heather, eucalyptus and others), packed honey and pollen. Examples verified from snippets: bulk multifloral 3.26 / 3.38 / 3.34 / 3.57 EUR/kg (late 2021 to early 2022) and 2.55-2.75 EUR/kg (2019/20). The sector indicators add hive numbers by region (REGA), number of beekeepers and production estimates.
sources.value_for_parodi: An official EU-producer bulk price for multifloral and named monofloral honeys (orange blossom/azahar, rosemary). It is a direct benchmark against import unit values (for example China at about 1.9 EUR/kg in Comext) and against Italian ISMEA/ONM prices. Spain is the EU's first or second producer, so its prices anchor 'EU honey' quotes.
sources.parsing_notes: PDF tables, with month columns and honey-type rows; use pdfplumber. Layout changes between campaigns, so version the parser by campaign. Campaign years run across calendar years. Discover the newest report by crawling the MAPA statistics 'novedades' pages, since the tcm IDs are random.
sources.sample_response: VERIFIED fragment (snippet): 'Miel Multifloral a Granel 3,26 3,38 3,34 3,57' (EUR/kg, decimal comma)

sources.name: FranceAgriMer: Observatoire de la production de miel et de gelée royale, and the annual 'Fiche filière apiculture'
sources.official_body: FranceAgriMer (national agency for agricultural and sea products, under the Ministère de l'Agriculture)
endpoints: Expected next edition (2025 data, around July 2026): https://www.franceagrimer.fr/sites/default/files/2026-07/…   (path pattern inferred, unverified)
sources.cost_licensing: Free; public-agency publication; cite FranceAgriMer (reuse terms unverified).
sources.update_frequency: annual (observatory around July; sector sheet around January/February)
sources.publication_lag: about 6-7 months after the harvest year
sources.data_available: French honey production (verified: 21,585 t in 2024, down 28% y/y), yields per hive, hive and beekeeper numbers, marketing channels, and prices: bulk (vrac) price by honey type in EUR/kg and direct-sale/retail prices (verified: average 11.68 EUR/kg across distribution channels). Organic premium of about 2-2.3 EUR/kg (verified). Commentary on the 2023 bulk price collapse under cheap imports.
sources.value_for_parodi: Official French bulk-price and harvest data, for an EU-origin supply and price benchmark (lavender, acacia, chestnut, sunflower, multifloral). Also useful for consumer-market context in France, a large importer. Comext has no prices or production.
sources.parsing_notes: PDF only; the file paths change with every upload (/sites/default/files/YYYY-MM/…). Discover via the FranceAgriMer apiculture page, then parse with pdfplumber and version by edition.

sources.name: Destatis GENESIS-Online, foreign trade statistics 51000 (Außenhandel) by 8-digit commodity number and country, via the GENESIS RESTful/JSON web service
sources.official_body: Statistisches Bundesamt (Destatis), Federal Statistical Office of Germany
sources.access_method: REST API (POST with form parameters; JSON or flat-file CSV). Verified from the Destatis docs snippet: the SOAP interface has been switched off, and the GET methods with credentials were replaced by POST methods. The method 'data/tablefile' is documented in section 2.5.12 of 'GENESIS-Webservices Einführung' v5.1 (01.06.2026).
endpoints: POST https://www-genesis.destatis.de/genesisWS/rest/2020/data/tablefile   (form params: name={table code}, area=all, format=ffcsv|csv|xlsx, compress=false, transpose=false, startyear=2024, endyear=2026, timeslices=, classifyingvariable1={commodity variable}, classifyingkey1={honey code}, classifyingvariable2={country variable}, classifyingkey2=*, language=en, job=false; credentials in HTTP headers 'username' and 'password', or the API token as username with an empty password). Parameter names are from memory; the method name is verified.

POST https://www-genesis.destatis.de/genesisWS/rest/2020/catalogue/tables   (selection=51000*, pagelength=500 → list the 51000 tables; pick the 'Monate, Länder, Warenverzeichnis (8-Steller)' variant. Its number is unverified, probably in the 51000-0013…0016 range)
POST https://www-genesis.destatis.de/genesisWS/rest/2020/metadata/table   (name={table code} → variable codes for the commodity and country dimensions)
sources.auth: Free registration plus API token. Verified (restatis docs): the token is found under 'Webservice-Schnittstelle (API)' in the account menu, and token sessions cannot create background jobs. Anonymous guest access was historically possible for small tables; current status unverified.
sources.cost_licensing: Free. Datenlizenz Deutschland - Namensnennung - Version 2.0 (dl-de/by-2-0); attribution 'Statistisches Bundesamt (Destatis)' (memory).
sources.publication_lag: About 40-45 days after month end (monthly trade press release with GENESIS tables updated the same day; memory)
sources.data_available: Einfuhr (imports) and Ausfuhr (exports) by Warennummer 8-digit (04090000) × Land (partner country) × Monat. Weight in tonnes and value in thousand EUR, giving EUR/kg. Memory: German national import statistics are published by country of ORIGIN (Ursprungsland), including intra-EU flows where reported, whereas Eurostat uses consignment for intra-EU flows.
sources.value_for_parodi: Germany is the EU's largest importer of extra-EU honey (about 68,000 t in 2025 according to Eurostat-based reporting). The data largely duplicates Comext (reporter DE). It adds value only where the origin-based view differs, for example Ukrainian honey arriving via Poland would show as Ukraine, and as an official German cross-check. Destatis has no honey production statistics.
sources.rate_limits: Not documented in what could be read. Large tables must go through job=true, which needs a username/password session because tokens cannot create jobs. Keep queries narrow (one commodity × all countries × 24 months).
sources.parsing_notes: 1) The ffcsv flat file is semicolon-separated with a decimal comma. Special values: '-' = nil, '.' = confidential, '...' = not yet available, 'x' = not meaningful, so treat them as null, never 0. 2) Variable codes for commodity and country (e.g. a WAM8-type variable with keys like 'WA04090000') are from memory; read them via metadata/table. 3) Provisional months are revised, so re-pull 12-24 months. 4) Convert thousand EUR × 1000 / (t × 1000) to EUR/kg.
sources.sample_response: RECONSTRUCTED ffcsv header (unverified): Statistik_Code;Statistik_Label;Zeit_Code;Zeit_Label;Zeit;1_Merkmal_Code;1_Merkmal_Label;1_Auspraegung_Code;1_Auspraegung_Label;2_Merkmal_Code;…;Einfuhr: Gewicht (t);Einfuhr: Wert (Tsd. EUR);Ausfuhr: Gewicht (t);Ausfuhr: Wert (Tsd. EUR)

https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/static_files/Sede/Tema/Aduanas/Comercio_exterior/Nuevo_formato_2026_max_des/Nota_inf_cierre_continuo26.pdf   (note on the new 2026 CSV format; verified)
Download page: the 'Estadísticas de comercio exterior → descarga de datos' section on sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es (exact ZIP URLs not found)
sources.cost_licensing: Free. Spanish public-sector information reuse with attribution to AEAT (memory; datos.gob.es licence field to be checked).
sources.publication_lag: About 50 days. Verified example: November 2025 data scheduled for 20 Jan 2026 (Hacienda publication calendar).
sources.data_available: Summary file (verified): period (month/year), flow, country of origin/destination, Combined Nomenclature code, value in euro CENTS, plus weight. Maximum-detail file (verified via the Madrid statistics office layout): province of origin/destination, country, TARIC code, net weight (kg), supplementary units, invoiced amount, statistical value, province of fiscal domicile. Honey: CN 04090000 / TARIC 0409000000.
sources.value_for_parodi: Official Spanish trade (Spain is a major producer, importer from China, Ukraine and Portugal, and exporter). It is the same data as Comext reporter ES. It adds province and TARIC detail and continuous revisions, but gives no price signal beyond Comext.
sources.rate_limits: n/a (static files; tens to hundreds of MB per year)
sources.parsing_notes: The traditional files are fixed-width TXT inside ZIP: apply the PDF record layout and divide values by 100 (cents). The 2026 CSV deliberately does not match the traditional files because of extra information and continuous updates, so pick one and stay with it. Monthly provisional files include late declarations from earlier months.

Key structural finding: for EU member states (IT, DE, ES, FR, HU, RO, PL), national customs and statistics trade data come from the same Intrastat/Extrastat declarations as Eurostat Comext DS-045409, which is already integrated. Building per-country trade collectors for them adds little price signal. National official sources earn their place only where they add (a) non-EU exporter data (Ukraine, Serbia), (b) prices or harvest/hive data that Comext lacks, or (c) sub-national or origin-based detail. Also, ISTAT Coeweb no longer exists (closed 30 Sep 2025, last update 11 Sep 2025). Its successor 'Statistiche del commercio estero' runs on the IstatData/esploradati platform, so any Coeweb-based plan must be redirected.

Build order for Paladex (ranked by value to a bulk buyer):
1) HIGH: Ukraine State Customs Service export data (UKTZED 0409000000 × destination × month, USD and t, giving USD/kg). First check on data.gov.ua (CKAN API: package_search) whether the published granularity reaches honey × country. If it does, this is the freshest official Ukrainian export price and covers non-EU destinations. If not, keep the media-quoted customs figures labelled third-party.
2) MEDIUM, price series Comext cannot give: Hungary AKI PÁIR honey purchase prices (acacia/rapeseed/sunflower/multifloral, HUF/kg; existence to be confirmed); Spain MAPA 'Precios del sector miel' (bulk multifloral and monofloral EUR/kg, annual PDF, latest found 2023/24); FranceAgriMer honey observatory (production 21,585 t in 2024, bulk prices by type, annual PDF, July). Implement these as versioned PDF parsers with a manual-review step. Always show campaign/period and publication date.
3) MEDIUM: ISTAT new foreign-trade database. Use it for the official Italian figure and especially province/region × origin detail (competitor sourcing). Use the SDMX REST service (esploradati.istat.it/SDMXWS/rest) if the trade cube is exposed; otherwise capture the databrowser export call. Respect the reported ~5 requests/min limit.
4) MEDIUM: Destatis GENESIS (POST genesisWS/rest/2020/data/tablefile with an API token). Use it for the origin-based German import view only; first discover the exact 8-digit × country × month table via catalogue/tables selection=51000*. Serbia RZS and Ukraine Derzhstat give the annual harvest and hive counts, plus Serbian monthly exports if tariff-line detail exists.
5) LOW: AEAT files, DataComex, French customs open data, KSH, INS TEMPO, GUS BDL/DBW and Italy's BDN hive census are all duplicative of Comext, or annual only. Add them later as cross-checks or a 'supply context' panel. DGCCRF and Derzhprodspozhyvsluzhba are event/compliance feeds, not time series.

Engineering notes: store every value with source, reference period, publication date and unit (EUR vs USD vs HUF vs PLN; t vs kg; thousand EUR vs cents). Convert with the already-integrated ECB rates. Treat special symbols ('-', '.', '...', 'x') as null. Re-pull revised recent months. Add startup schema probes for the undocumented backends (TEMPO, ISTAT databrowser).
